description: US train accidents and derailments reported to the Federal Railroad Administration (FRA Form 54, 1975–present). Returns individual rail equipment accident reports — derailments, train collisions, obstruction and other impacts — with date, reporting railroad (e.g. UP, BNSF, CSX, NS, Amtrak), accident type, FRA primary cause code and description (e.g. H702 "Switch improperly lined", T110 "Wide gage"), state and county, train speed, hazmat cars released, people evacuated, killed, injured and damage cost. Newest first. Filter by year, state, railroad, cause code or accident type. Use for "train derailments in Ohio in 2023", "Norfolk Southern accidents", "rail accidents caused by broken rails".

accident_type.description: Accident type text, matched as a substring: "Derailment", "Head on collision", "Rear end collision", "Side collision", "Raking collision", "Hwy-rail crossing", "Obstruction", "Fire/violent rupture", "Other impacts".

cause_code.description: FRA accident cause code or its prefix: "H702" exactly, or "T" for all track causes, "H" human factors, "E" equipment, "S" signal, "M" miscellaneous.

min_damage_usd.description: Only accidents with total reported damage at or above this amount in US dollars.

railroad.description: Reporting railroad: a reporting-mark code ("UP", "BNSF", "CSX", "NS", "ATK") or part of its name ("Norfolk Southern").

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or full name, e.g. "OH" or "Ohio".

year.description: Calendar year of the accident (1975–present), e.g. 2023.

name: rail_accidents
title: Rail Accidents
